title: HR Administrator
description:
24 hours a week (can be worked over 3 or 4 days)

Crowne Plaza Nottingham is looking for an HR Administrator to keep the people side of the hotel running accurately, on time, and with the right level of care for confidential information.

The Role

This role sits at the centre of the hotel's people processes - part data, part onboarding, part general manager support. You'll be the first point of contact for team member queries on people reporting, and the person making sure records, files and systems stay accurate as people join, move through, and leave the business. Day to day, you'll:
- Keep HR systems updated with accurate, current data, and run regular audits and data-cleansing across those systems
- Act as the first point of contact for Team Member queries relating to people reporting
- Develop and improve team reporting so it stays relevant as the business changes
- Support the recruitment process, helping Heads of Department set up interviews and communicate with candidates
- Deliver induction and onboarding for every new starter, so they get a proper welcome from day one
- Maintain a complete personnel file for each team member - application form, offer letter, contract, references, declarations, signed job description, induction receipt, working time directive documentation and right-to-work evidence
- Keep statutory training records current, and coordinate attendance on company training courses, including pre- and post-course briefings with managers
- Take minutes at management meetings, and type and distribute them accordingly
- Monitor sickness and absence levels, track lost productivity, and ensure return-to-work meetings happen promptly
- Provide administrative support to the General Manager, including letters, reports, meeting organisation and confidential material
- Coordinate travel arrangements, meetings and hotel planners across the team
- Handle telephone, email and face-to-face enquiries professionally and responsively
- Support the General Manager, Operations Manager and Department Managers with employee relations documentation and team member celebrations
- Keep Team Member notice boards, including the Internal Vacancy Board, tidy and up to date with current legislation and company information
- Coordinate work experience placements with local schools, colleges and universities
- Handle all confidential information professionally and discreetly at all times
- Follow cash and key handling, fire, security (including GDPR and PCI DSS), and Health & Safety procedures as laid down by the hotel and company
- Comply with hotel and company rules as set out in the team member handbook
- Represent the business's cultural values - passionate, real, inspiring, dynamic and enthusiastic - day to day

Supporting Your Hospitality Career Growth

We invest in the people who work with us. That includes apprenticeship routes into supervisory and management roles, ongoing on-the-job training, and recognition through our service awards for long-serving team members.

About the Hotel

Crowne Plaza Nottingham sits in the heart of Nottingham city centre, a 15-minute walk from Nottingham railway station and just five minutes from the Victoria Centre shopping area. The hotel is a popular choice for both business and leisure guests, with 210 bedrooms, 17 flexible meeting and event spaces catering for up to 400 guests, and the Urban Escape Spa offering a pool, jacuzzi, steam room and gym. Guests dine at the Lace Maker Restaurant for breakfast and Swatch Restaurant & Bar for lunch, dinner and drinks, and the hotel regularly hosts conferences, private events and celebrations for guests visiting the city, including those attending the nearby Royal Centre.

Benefits
- Discounted hotel stays and food & beverage across Valor Hospitality properties, for you and your friends/family
- Wellbeing support, including access to an Employee Assistance Programme
- Ongoing training and development, with clear routes into supervisory and management roles
- Recognition through long-service and performance awards
- Pension scheme and workplace perks in line with Valor Hospitality's standard offering

Ready to Join Us?

We're an equal opportunities employer, and we welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of race disability, religion or belief, sexual orientation or age. At Valor Hospitality, we actively welcome applications from candidates of all diverse backgrounds.

Every application is carefully reviewed against the relevant skills and experience for the role, and we'll be in touch if you're a good match and have been selected for interview.

If you need any support at any stage of the recruitment process, or reasonable adjustments to help you do your best, please email our team at .

Please note that employment is subject to proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

title: Operations Assistant
description:
Operations Assistant - Law Firm

Location: Nottingham

Salary: Competitive, £26,000 - £30,000 per annum

Type: Permanent

Sector: Legal / Professional Services

The Opportunity

We are working with a well-established national law firm with specialist expertise in business law, agriculture, food and farming, to recruit an Operations Assistant for its Nottingham office.

This is an excellent opportunity for a professional, organised and personable individual to join a respected law firm in a varied, office-based role. Acting as the first point of contact for visitors, you will play a key role in creating a welcoming and professional environment while providing essential administrative and operational support to the wider office.

Working under the guidance of the Operations Team Leader and Manager, you will help ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the office, supporting colleagues and delivering a high standard of service to clients and visitors.

Key Responsibilities
- Act as the first point of contact for visitors to the Nottingham office, providing a professional and welcoming reception service.
- Provide day-to-day administrative and operational support to ensure the smooth running of the office.
- Assist with general office coordination and facilities-related tasks.
- Support colleagues with administrative requests and operational requirements.
- Help maintain a professional, organised and efficient working environment.
- Liaise with internal teams and external contacts as required.
- Ensure visitors and clients receive a positive experience when attending the office.
- Undertake general administrative duties and support wider operational activities as required.

About You

We are looking for someone who is proactive, approachable and highly organised, with a strong customer service ethos and the ability to manage a varied workload.

The ideal candidate will have:
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- A professional and confident telephone manner.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and completing tasks.
- The ability to prioritise competing demands and work effectively as part of a team.
- Good IT and general administrative skills.
- A friendly, professional manner and a commitment to delivering excellent service.

Previous experience in an administrative, reception, office support or customer-facing role would be advantageous. Experience within a law firm or professional services environment would also be beneficial but is not essential.

What's on Offer?

This is a great opportunity to join a respected national law firm and develop your career within a professional services environment.

You will be part of a collaborative team, gain exposure to a broad range of office operations and play an important role in supporting the day-to-day success of the Nottingham office.

Apply today or contact Natalie Dwan at LJ Recruitment for a confidentail discussion.

title: Credit Controller
company: The Accountancy Recruitment Group Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Credit Controller Beeston (hybrid working) £28,000 - £32,000 (plus benefits package)

The Opportunity

Are you an experienced Credit Controller looking for your next opportunity within a growing business?

Longstanding SME based in Beeston are looking for an experienced Credit Controller to join their small, collaborative finance team, taking responsibility for managing customer accounts, reducing outstanding debt and supporting effective cash flow across the business.

This is a varied role offering the opportunity to take full ownership of a busy and sometimes complex debtor ledger, build strong customer relationships and also contribute to the wider finance function.

This is an environment where you can really add value and be recognised for your achievements, you will enjoy the flexibility of hybrid working and a sensible work life balance, while being able to put your own stamp on your role with full autonomy.

The Role

Reporting to the Finance Manager, you will be responsible for the day-to-day management of customer accounts and credit control activities, ensuring outstanding balances are collected efficiently while maintaining a professional and customer-focused approach.

Your remit will include:
- Proactively contacting customers to secure payment of overdue invoices and reduce aged debt.
- Managing high-volume and complex debtor ledgers, working towards agreed cash collection targets.
- Maintaining accurate records of customer communications, payment arrangements and account activity.
- Setting up and maintaining customer accounts, including updating account details and status information.
- Monitoring customer credit limits and spend limits in line with company policies.
- Carrying out customer due diligence and creditworthiness checks.
- Administering direct debit instructions, processing collections and resolving rejected payments.
- Reconciling direct debit holding accounts and investigating discrepancies.
- Posting and reconciling cash receipts from factoring accounts.
- Allocating receipts across multi-currency accounts, including euro transactions.
- Supporting consolidated invoicing processes for key customers.
- Utilising the system to enhance and develop reporting

You will need:

We're looking for someone with previous experience in credit control, accounts receivable who knows what strong credit control processes look like!

You will ideally have:
- A good understanding of credit control processes, debt collection and account management.
- Experience managing busy customer ledgers and prioritising collection activity.
- Previous experience using accounting or ERP systems.
- Good Microsoft Excel and general IT skills.
- Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the confidence to deal with customers professionally.
- Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to financial administration.
- Strong organisation and time-management skills.
- Experience with direct debit administration, cash flow processes, financial reconciliations or multi-currency accounts would be advantageous.

Apply now

If you would like to be considered for the Credit Controller role in Beeston, please click 'apply now' or contact our team direct.

title: Repair Coordinator
description:
Repair Coordinator

Nottingham Salary DOE

About the Role

MPJ Recruitment are proud to be working with an established insurance business, who are currently looking for an organised and proactive Repair Coordinator to join their Nottingham team.

You'll be at the heart of the repair process, coordinating works from instruction through to completion and acting as a key point of contact for contractors, surveyors, adjusters, customers and internal teams.

This is a fast-paced and varied role where you'll manage multiple priorities, keep repairs on track and resolve issues quickly and effectively.

What You'll Be Doing

- Schedule works and monitor progress against agreed timescales.
- Liaise with contractors, surveyors, adjusters and customers, keeping all parties informed.
- Monitor drying, reinstatement works, delays and variations.
- Proactively chase updates, photographs and supporting documentation.
- Maintain accurate repair records and internal systems.
- Ensure works remain within approved scopes and authorisations.
- Identify and escalate delays, complaints, risks and service issues.
- Support final accounts and repair-related administration.
- Maintain contractor compliance records, insurance, accreditations and renewal dates.
- Assist with contractor on-boarding and compliance checks.

About You

We're looking for someone who is highly organised, dependable and confident dealing with a wide range of people. You'll be comfortable managing competing priorities, working to deadlines and finding practical solutions when challenges arise.

Ideally, you'll have:
- Experience in administration, repair coordination, insurance claims, contractor management or a similar operational role.
- Strong organisational and record-keeping skills.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- A customer-focused, solutions-driven approach.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to prioritise.
- Confidence using Microsoft Office and operational systems.

Desirable Experience
- Background in insurance claims or property repairs.
- Understanding of reinstatement or restoration works.
- Experience managing contractor compliance.
- Experience using Apex or similar systems.
- Understanding of general insurance and property claims processes.

Benefits:
- A competitive salary
- Employee Benefits including cash back on basic health care, discounted gym memberships and retail discounts
- Employee Assistance Plan and access to wide range of healthcare services for you and your immediate family
- Group Life Assurance
- Professional development and support
- Opportunity to progress your career within a growing organisation
- A collaborative, supportive and high-performing team culture.

Why Join Us?

This is an excellent opportunity to join a collaborative team where you'll have a real impact on the customer journey and successful delivery of repairs.

You'll enjoy a varied workload, build strong industry relationships and play an important role in keeping the repair operation running smoothly.

If you're organised, personable and enjoy taking ownership to get things done, we'd love to hear from you.

Click apply today!

title: Marketing and Campaigns Coordinator
description:
Great ideas deserve to be brought to life. Could you be the person to make that happen?

£28,000 FTE £12,800 actual salary 16 hours per week Hybrid working Mansfield

We can offer

Flexible part-time hours: 16 hours per week, with the working pattern agreed to suit both you and the business.

Hybrid working: A minimum of 50% of your working hours based at our Mansfield office.

Real involvement: The opportunity to take responsibility for campaigns and see the results of your work.

Support and collaboration: Direct access to the people making business decisions, with opportunities to contribute your own ideas.

Variety: A role that combines creative work, research, planning and practical delivery.

Do you enjoy turning ideas into engaging content? Are you someone who takes pride in the details, likes having a clear plan and gets satisfaction from seeing your work make a difference?

Perhaps you've worked in marketing for a few years and are now looking for a role that offers greater flexibility without losing the opportunity to use your skills, contribute ideas and take ownership of your work.

What makes this opportunity different?

We're not looking for someone to arrive with a completely new marketing strategy or reinvent our business, we already know who our customers are, understand the challenges they face and have developed ideas for campaigns we want to deliver. We need someone who enjoys the practical side of marketing. Someone who can take an idea, think about the best way to communicate it, create the materials, organise the activity and see it through to completion.

You'll have the freedom to be creative, the support of an experienced team and the satisfaction of seeing the results of your work.

What will you be doing?
- Bringing campaigns to life: Turning our marketing ideas into engaging, well-planned campaigns that reach the right businesses.
- Creating great content: Producing LinkedIn posts, graphics, email campaigns, newsletters, brochures and other promotional materials.
- Finding the right audience: Researching prospective customers and understanding the businesses and people we want to engage with.
- Keeping everything organised: Maintaining a marketing calendar, coordinating activities and ensuring campaigns happen when planned.
- Making our message stand out: Finding interesting, clear and professional ways to explain how LivePay helps businesses.
- Seeing what works: Monitoring engagement and campaign results, identifying improvements and sharing your findings.
- Contributing your ideas: Working with our Customer Development Manager and Managing Director to develop and improve our marketing activities.

What experience would help?

Ideally, you'll have some practical experience in marketing, communications, content creation or a similar role. We're looking for someone who brings creativity, enthusiasm and organisation, takes pride in their work and is comfortable taking ownership of tasks, asking questions and listening to feedback.

We'd particularly welcome experience in:
- Creating professional, engaging written content.
- Managing LinkedIn or other business social media campaigns.
- Using Canva or similar design tools.
- Producing email marketing campaigns and promotional materials.
- Researching prospective customers or target audiences.
- Organising marketing activities and managing deadlines.
- Using CRM systems, website tools or marketing analytics.

Experience of business-to-business marketing would be helpful, but it's not essential. You don't need to be an expert in payroll. We'll help you understand our services and our customers.

We're more interested in what you can do, how you approach your work and the pride you take in delivering it than in a long list of qualifications.

A little about us

At LivePay, we've been helping businesses manage their payroll for over 45 years. We're an independent, family-run business with a straightforward approach: combine great technology with knowledgeable, friendly people who genuinely care about the customers they support. We have plenty of experience, lots of knowledge to share and some exciting ideas about how we can reach more businesses.

What we don't have is enough time to bring all those ideas to life. That's where you come in.

Interested? We'd love to see what you can do.

We'd love to hear about your experience and see examples of marketing materials, campaigns or content you've helped create.

Apply with your CV and a short introduction explaining why this role interests you.
